Following the [tutorial](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/amt/vignettes/p4_SSF.html) by Johannes Signer.

```{r}
# -----loading packages-----
# general use
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(here)

# spatial
library(terra)
library(amt) # ssf

```

```{r}
# -----loading data-----
ele_data <- read_csv(here("data", "elephant_2010-Feb2020.csv"))
```

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Step 1: Getting the data ready
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
```{r}
# cleaning data
ele_clean <- ele_data |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  mutate(dt = mdy_hm(dt))

# structure tracking data
ele_trk <- make_track(ele_clean,
                      .x = lon, .y = lat, .t = dt,
                      id = id, crs = 4326)
```

```{r}
summarize_sampling_rate(ele_trk)
```

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Step 2: Prepare data for SSF
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

```{r}
ele_trk_reg <- ele_trk |> 
  # nest all data except for id
  nest(data = -id) |> 
  # for every xyt in data, resample and create steps by burst, and store in 'steps' column
  mutate(steps = map(data, function(x) {
    x |>
      track_resample(rate = hours(1), tolerance = minutes(15)) |>
      steps_by_burst()
  })) |>
  # select id and steps column
  select(id, steps) |> 
  # unnest everything in steps column
  unnest(cols = steps)
```
